facts.fact: The Africa Brief report treats Malawi's 2017 Access to Information Act as law in force, applied by the High Court.
The Human Rights Commission, tasked under Section 7 of the Act with overseeing its implementation, moved in January 2023 to assess Mota-Engil's compliance.

note: The court ruling concerns a compliance assessment, not a request made under the law, so it is not recorded as applied.
